title: Review of Security Officers' Working Conditions and of Penalties for Abuse of Security Officers
what_it_is: Review of Security Officers' Working Conditions and of Penalties for Abuse of Security Officers

sections.label: Private Security Industry Act amendments
sections.summary: MHA amended the Private Security Industry Act in October 2021 to add offences for abuse and harassment of security officers, with higher penalties.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In October 2021, MHA amended the Private Security Industry Act (PSIA) to enhance protections for them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: New offences addressing the common types of abuse and harassment were introduced, with penalties pegged higher than if they were committed against general members of the public.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Given that it has only been six months since, it is too early to conclude on their impact.

sections.label: Police body-worn camera approvals
sections.summary: From 2019 to October 2022, the Police approved 46 requests by 16 licensed security agencies to use body-worn cameras.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: From 2019 to October 2022, the Police approved 46 requests by 16 licensed security agencies for the use of body-worn cameras.

sections.label: Security technology and body-worn cameras
sections.summary: 97% of security agencies use at least one technology solution, and whether body-worn cameras are compulsory is for buyers and providers to discuss.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For instance, today, 97% of security agencies use at least one technology solution, such as mobile-enabled patrol and incident management systems as well as the use of wearable technology, like what the Member mentioned, body-worn cameras.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: That said, on whether or not to make body-worn cameras compulsory, these are issues to be discussed between the service buyer and the service provider.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We have to take into account various factors, such as the needs of the buyer, the deployment location, as well as the costs that may be required.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As I have mentioned in my main reply, it has only been about six months since the amendments came into effect in May 2022.
